findings.explanation: Payment is due within 45 days after invoice confirmation, which is slower than the standard 30 days and creates cash flow delays.
findings.suggested_change: After PC Financial confirms that invoice contents are correct, PC Financial shall pay within thirty (30) days after confirming thus.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to request one small adjustment before I sign. - Regarding the relevant clause stating that payment is due within 45 days after invoice confirmation, this is a bit longer than my standard terms and impacts cash flow, so I propose modifying it to state that payment shall be made within thirty (30) days. Thank you for understanding, and I look forward to moving forward. Best regards
